description: Manifest cases of validateManifest (packages/plugin-api/index.js). The plugin-api runner, the pack and the install of sok replay every case: a case with `accepted` true is accepted, and a case with `error` is refused with exactly that text. `files` lists the package files of the case; pack writes the package from them, and each listed file exists and is empty.
